phaseNumbering: History: phases 1-4 were each scoped and delivered as a single journey step from docs/MASTER-PLAN.md §4. After id 4, this project's git history split into two independently-developed branches, each needing journey-step work that didn't fit any open original-10-phase id: one branch built a real Security Engine and continued the journey (Eligibility/Availability/Alternatives/Quote), appending those at ids 6 and 11-14 rather than renumbering; the other (this branch) built a Gemini-backed conversational reply engine on top of the official WhatsApp channel adapter. Both branches' phase-numbered docs (docs/PHASE-2.md, docs/PHASE-5-CHANNELS.md, docs/PHASE-6.md, docs/PHASE-11.md … docs/PHASE-14.md, docs/phases/PHASE-06.md, …) were written under those branches' own id schemes and were NOT renamed during the 2026-09-25 merge+renumber below — each phase's `phaseDoc` field is the authoritative pointer to its actual detail; the filename's own number is historical, not necessarily this document's current id for that phase. On 2026-09-25 the two branches were merged and, per explicit request, every phase below was renumbered into one clean sequential list (id order = dependency/build order) rather than the prior 'append at the next free integer' scheme — dependsOn was re-derived from the original graph, not fabricated as a flat chain: id 8 (Alternatives) still depends specifically on id 7 (Availability), not on id 6 (Eligibility), because that was true in the original graph regardless of id numbers. Any future work gets the next free sequential id.
